findings.subject: browser
findings.title: The execute callback receives one argument, not two
findings.expected: execute(input, options) with options.signal an AbortSignal

findings.subject: browser
findings.title: inputSchema is written as an object and read back as a string
findings.expected: typeof tool.inputSchema === "object", per the W3C draft

findings.subject: browser
findings.title: consequentialHint is in the IDL and not in this build
findings.expected: consequentialHint survives registration, per Chromium model_context_tool.idl

findings.subject: browser
findings.title: No route makes a refusal both a failure and readable
findings.expected: at least one route where the promise signals failure AND carries the page’s reason
findings.observed: return { isError: true }: resolved | throw Error: rejected, name=UnknownError, reason survived=false | reject DOMException("InvalidStateError"): rejected, name=UnknownError, reason survived=false

findings.subject: browser
findings.title: isError is payload, not a signal
findings.expected: returning { isError: true } is surfaced to the caller as a failure
findings.observed: the promise resolved, so the caller reads success

findings.subject: browser
findings.title: The MCP annotation names do not exist in WebMCP
findings.expected: the 3 backend MCP annotation names survive registration
findings.observed: 3 of 3 dropped with no error and no console warning: destructiveHint, idempotentHint, openWorldHint. Counted by another row and not here: consequentialHint is row A3

findings.subject: browser
findings.title: A declarative tool carries no annotations at all
findings.expected: A form promoted to a tool says whether it only reads.
findings.reason: the transcript carries no observation for this behaviour

findings.subject: browser
findings.title: The caller cannot tell whether to parse the result
findings.expected: the caller can distinguish a text result from a data result
findings.observed: a string handler gave typeof "string" (does not parse as JSON), an object handler gave typeof "string" (parses as JSON)

findings.subject: browser
findings.title: A missing required property is filled from the control’s stale value
findings.expected: A call that omits a required property is refused.
findings.reason: submitting a form was not authorised. Pass --allow-fixture-forms, which additionally runs only against a page that passes the bundled fixture identity check

findings.subject: browser
findings.title: A tool withdraws only when the signal is in the options bag
findings.expected: aborting the signal withdraws the tool, wherever the signal was passed
findings.observed: signal in the options bag: withdraws; signal on the descriptor: does NOT withdraw, and nothing is thrown

findings.subject: browser
